claims.summary: For M >= 2, 1 <= k <= M-1 and every partition mu with at most k+1 parts, at the M-th roots of unity H_mu = sum_(|S|=k+1) Vand(y_S)^2 s_mu(y_S) equals +-M^(k+1) if the exponents mu + delta have residues exactly {0, -1, ..., -k} mod M, and 0 otherwise; the least weight of a nonzero H_mu is k(M-k-1), attained only by the rectangle ((M-k-1)^k).
claims.assessment: Working proof (bialternant and Cauchy-Binet: H_mu = +- det[p_(a+b)], a permutation-or-singular 0/1 matrix at roots of unity); exact check of 298 cases, M = 4, 5, |mu| <= 8 (research/results/bmd-20261009-kex/residue-criterion.txt); reviewed by one fresh-context medium reviewer.
claims.rationale: Determines exactly which Schur-Hankel sums survive at regular polygons in the residual Omega_k, and the least weight of a surviving sum, k(M-k-1).
claims.next_action: Constant coefficient of the rectangle in the multi-column expansion of the raised sets of weight k(M-k-1).

relationships: Implies its part (4) (one-row shapes vanish for 2 <= k <= M-2).
Its weight k(M-k-1) is one of the raises the lemma allows.
